verdict.conclusion: The in-in quadrature engine does NOT reproduce the Maldacena squeezed consistency relation f_NL^sq=(5/12)(1-n_s) on de Sitter to acceptable sign+magnitude (2/5 cases pass, and the 2 that pass do so only because their target is ~0). Per the mandatory calibration gate, a bounce delta_f_NL from this uncalibrated machinery is NOT reported (would violate pattern-036). The prior Path-Z SHAPE result stands (scale-independent transfer => bispectrum shape preserved) but the AMPLITUDE remains non-derivable by direct single-vertex in-in quadrature at this fidelity. P2 f_NL=-35/8 STAYS CONDITIONAL (assumption d). NO paper edit.
verdict.root_cause: RIGOROUS, SPECIFIC reason the method cannot derive the amplitude: the engine's squeezed f_NL is IDENTICALLY INDEPENDENT of the second slow-roll parameter eta_sr (verified: f_NL_total = -0.04719 for eta_sr in {-0.04,-0.02,0,+0.02,+0.04} at eps=0.02). But the Maldacena consistency amplitude (5/12)(1-n_s) = (5/12)(2 eps + eta_sr) DEPENDS LINEARLY on eta_sr. The consistency relation is generated by a delicate cancellation among ALL Maldacena cubic vertices PLUS the field redefinition PLUS the eta_sr-correction to the mode function (the exact massless-dS Hankel mode carries no eta_sr info). A truncated single-dominant-vertex quadrature on exact-dS modes structurally CANNOT reproduce the tilt-locked squeezed amplitude in sign or magnitude. This is why the prior Path-Z contraction-only benchmark missed -35/8 by ~2.5x: same defect. Amplitude-faithfulness for an in-in f_NL requires either (a) the complete vertex set with the field redefinition AND slow-roll-corrected modes on the calibration side, then carried consistently to the bounce, or (b) a second-order matching across the bounce. Neither is achievable by patching the single-vertex quadrature; it is the wrong-order object for an amplitude.
verdict.what_stands: SHAPE result from prior Path Z is unaffected and remains valid: |T_growing| and T3 are scale-independent across the k-tower, so the bounce preserves the bispectrum SHAPE (scale-independence). Only the AMPLITUDE (whether the -35/8 magnitude transfers 1:1) is non-derivable by this method.
